instruction:
Carry out `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref.cir` in native PSpice. Use the native PSpice command-line simulator `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\psp_cmd.exe`. For this workflow, use `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe` for OrCAD schematics and `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\allegro.exe` for board work.

Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref.out`, `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref.dat`. Then export the six native temperature points from `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref_measure.txt` into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\t_curve.csv`. The CSV header must be `T_C,Vout_V`, and the rows must be listed in increasing temperature order.
